elements.title: Python code for one-sample t-test example
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code showing import of scipy.stats and numpy, definition of oxygen_level data array with values [76, 75, 74, 81, 76, 77, 71, 74, 73, 79], null hypothesis mean = 75, performing one-sample t-test using stats.ttest_1samp, calculation of one-tailed p-value by dividing two-tailed p-value by 2, and printing test statistic and p-value. The resulting output is shown: Test Statistic = 0.6512171447631733, p-value = 0.2655900985964262.
elements.summary: This screenshot shows the Python code used to perform a one-sample t-test on oxygen level data, including calculation of the test statistic and one-tailed p-value, with the output displayed.
